name: Pounding hard-techno wall
desc: Hard-techno kick wall: heavily shaped 909 four with a detuned second kick smeared underneath for width, a bone-dry industrial clap, and almost nothing else — the hats are an afterthought by design. Peak drives the second kick onto the off-eighths for that relentless double-pound. For 150-in-spirit sets even at server tempo.

code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}), s("[~ bd]*4").bank("RolandTR909").speed(.92).lpf(600).shape(.4).gain(${gain}*.5), s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.35).gain(.5), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(".24 .14 .2 .14").ply("<1 1 1 2>"), s("sd(3,16,<4 8 12>)").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.24)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
